author: dilpickel
body:
Hello dilpickel here and I would like to show you my map!
Map Name: Melty candy.
Map Gamemode: Nebula DTM.
Map Creator: dilpickel.

Intro:
In this map players will have to work together and bridge across the melty platforms. Bow skills will be tested in the long range combat with precise sword skills needed to stay on the platforms. Use the special items in this map to get an advantage over your opponent.

Download: (yaml included) http://www.mediafire.com/download/m5eml1r8bg52h5t/Meltycandy.zip
Separate yaml: http://www.mediafire.com/download/k3o7gi6bnczhvxt/Meltymeltyicecream.yaml

Info: (per team).
12 hard to get to diamond blocks.
6 ice cream cones. (filled with iron).
11 platforms.
9 cookies.
2 monuments. 
1 Candy Corn tower.
47 snow balls.
1 splash potion of regeneration.
1 special item. (The slapper).
2 big piles of iron.
2 peach rings.
1 large ice cream sandwich. (With 3 chests with various loot.)
2 rainbow candy strips.
And 1 large spoon spawn point.

Teams are 20 v 20.

ADDED: 1 large ice cream sandwich with 3 chests. 2 rainbow candy strips. (As bridges.)
REMOVED: Space between the platforms. Space between the 2 teams. One platform changed to ice cream sandwich.
Here's some pictures:
http://imgur.com/a/ySS8Y (more pics).

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
I have to say I really like the aspect of the map as it looks very pleasant to the eye and it also looks as it'd have some neat neat NEAT gameplay. Something I'd have to point out is that the square islands are a bit... squarey, and you could improve that by giving them some other shape that looks more appealing and then again what I said on Eric's map, even though it may seem that the shape of the islands only contributes to the aesthetical side of the map, it also enhances gameplay for the good or the bad, but yeah if you properly change the shape of them (because to be honest the island that is right in front of the spawn area looks really thin and the shape looks kinda weird. Perhaps you could improve that one by simply editing that one front part that is straight and not curvy like the one on the other side, then continue to the squarey islands on both ends and do your magic man, I love how you built this map!).
There's different height levels, just what seems to be a correct amount of void, gameplay looks very, very interesting, and it pretty much made me hungry.
I'll accept this if you take my advice and improve the generic shape of the islands you used. Good luck man! even though you won't need it ;p
